description: One stock's options chain for this Friday and next (expiry Friday 8pm New York): per strike and side the series id, Borro's fair value (Black-Scholes from the stock's own measured volatility, a guide), delta, the best ask and bid (checked on chain), the IV the ask implies, the shares written and the last traded IV; the stock's price, its volatility a year and the last traded IV; and whether the desk is live, paused and its fee. Prices are dollars a share, premiums USDG a share.

symbol.description: A stock on Borro by its ticker, like NVDA or AAPL (markets lists every one)
